title: Lag Clearer 101
description: Lag clearer (Paper 1.21.11): A zero-config, lightweight plugin that automatically clears dropped items to stop lag only when your server's TPS drops below 10.
body:
A lightweight, zero-configuration server optimization plugin for PaperMC (1.21.11) that automatically clears dropped items *only* when your server actually needs it.

Unlike traditional clear-lag plugins that wipe items on a blind, repeating timer (which often frustrates players), OptimizerPlugin actively monitors your server's health and only intervenes during genuine lag spikes. 

### ✨ Features
* **Smart TPS Monitoring:** The plugin continuously checks your server's Ticks Per Second (TPS). It sits completely dormant while your server is running smoothly.
* **Emergency Sweeps:** If the server's TPS drops below 10.0 (indicating severe lag from massive mining sessions or entity cramming), it immediately removes all dropped item entities across all loaded worlds to free up memory.
* **Zero Configuration:** No complicated configs or permissions to set up. Just drop the `.jar` file into your `plugins` folder, restart your server, and it works instantly.
* **Admin Alerts:** Whenever an emergency sweep is triggered, it logs a clean report in the server console detailing the exact TPS and the number of items removed.

### ⚙️ Technical Details
* **Requirements:** Paper 1.21.11 (or forks like Purpur) and Java 21.
* **Performance:** Written to be incredibly lightweight with zero background overhead.

Ideal for survival servers, SMPs, or any server owner who wants automatic lag protection without annoying their player base!
